description: Deliberate Forma 0.x names (FORMA-NS-001) that Signal's guards must recognise. This is the only file in web, web-kernel, tests, tools and src that may hold them: the no-Forma-0.x guard (FoundationsConformanceTests) skips exactly this path, and the namespace codemod must be run with --exclude tests/fixtures/forma-zero-names.json (see HANDOFF.md, WI-0109). Never run the codemod in write mode over this file.
